# Tsang Sze Chun (Jacky Tsang)

> Personal site of Tsang Sze Chun (Jacky Tsang), an Android developer working in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Projects include apps for Ring, Dyson, HSBC and Hang Seng Bank.

The site is a single page: an introduction, links to profiles, a list of skills, and project cards that open into short write-ups.

## Profiles

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jacky-tsang-93646a193/): career history and skills
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jacky-ttt/): code
- [Medium](https://jacky-ttt.medium.com/): articles about the tools used at work

## Projects

- Ring (2024): organization-wide Android design system. Android, Compose, Kotlin, Coroutines, MVVM
- Dyson (2023): innovation team focused on AR and on-device AI integration. Android, Compose, Kotlin
- HSBC (2022): international payment module of the HSBC mobile banking app. Android, Kotlin, MVP, MVVM
- Daily Journal (2022): on-chain NFT that holds daily journals. Solidity, Hardhat, TypeScript, Next.js
- Hang Seng Bank (2019): Hong Kong Hang Seng Bank app. Android, Kotlin, MVP
- Cruzr (2019): navigation app that runs on a robot. Speech-to-text, DialogFlow, text-to-speech
- Stay Focused (2019): interactive 3D model viewer. React Native, Expo, Three.js
- Volumetric Lighting (2018): artistic visualization installation. C++, OpenCV, VTK
- Web Scraper (2017): automated web scraper. Python, Scrapy, Selenium, Puppeteer
- Greyed Out (2015): all-grey Android icon pack. Android, Java
- HKJC Data Grid (2015): data visualization desktop app. React, Electron, AG Grid
- HK G-Share (2014): second-hand trading platform. Android, Java, SQLite
- UNI Match (2014): networking and events platform for universities. Android, Java
